* Quy đổi ĐVT trên BC = Tỷ đồng: ROUND(Giá trị niêm yết / 1E9, 2)
column24:
-- Loại chứng khoán = TPDN niêm yết:
WITH periods AS (
  -- Thông tin ngày đầu kỳ, cuối kỳ của từng kỳ trong năm báo cáo:
  SELECT 
    'Q' || quy AS period_code,
    'Quý ' || quy AS period_name,
    ADD_MONTHS(ngay_gd(:P_YEAR || '0101', 'YYYYMMDD'), (quy - 1) * 3) AS fromdate,
    ADD_MONTHS(ngay_gd(:P_YEAR || '0101', 'YYYYMMDD'), quy * 3) - 1 AS todate
  FROM (SELECT LEVEL AS quy FROM dual CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 4) q
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    period_code,
    period_name,
    ngay_gd(:P_YEAR || fromdate, 'YYYYMMDD') AS fromdate,
    ngay_gd(:P_YEAR || todate, 'YYYYMMDD')   AS todate
  FROM (
    SELECT '6M' period_code, '6 tháng đầu năm' period_name, '0101' fromdate, '0630' todate FROM dual UNION ALL
    SELECT '9M' period_code, '9 tháng đầu năm' period_name, '0101' fromdate, '0930' todate FROM dual UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Y'  period_code, 'Cả năm'          period_name, '0101' fromdate, '1231' todate FROM dual
  )
) 
, daily_listedshare AS (
  -- Thông tin KL/GT niêm yết TPDNNY cuối mỗi ngày trong năm báo cáo
  SELECT
    tradingdate,
    symbol,
    listedshare,
    100000 * POWER(10, ROUND(LOG(10, reference / 100000))) AS parvalue,
    listedshare * 100000 * POWER(10, ROUND(LOG(10, reference / 100000))) AS listedshare_value
  FROM (
    SELECT
      s.tradingdate,
      s.symbol,
      s.listedshare,
      s.reference,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.symbol, s.tradingdate ORDER BY s.tradingtime DESC) AS rn
    FROM jad_stockinfor s
    WHERE s.stocktype = '1'
      AND ngay_gd(s.tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY') >= ngay_gd(:P_YEAR || '0101', 'YYYYMMDD')
      AND ngay_gd(s.tradingdate, 'DD/MM/YYYY') <= ngay_gd(:P_YEAR || '1231', 'YYYYMMDD')
  )
  WHERE rn = 1
)
, period_trade_dates AS (
  -- Ngày gần nhất có dữ liệu thông tin trái phiếu của từng kỳ (Do thông tin thị trường chỉ có dữ liệu theo ngày giao dịch)
  SELECT
    p.period_code,
    p.period_name,
    p.fromdate,
    p.todate,
    MAX(d.tradingdate) AS data_date
  FROM periods p
  LEFT JOIN daily_listedshare d
    ON d.tradingdate <= p.todate
   AND d.tradingdate >= p.fromdate
  GROUP BY p.period_code, p.period_name, p.fromdate, p.todate
)
-- Giá trị niêm yết TPDNNY từng kỳ trong năm báo cáo
SELECT
  p.period_code,
  p.period_name,
  p.fromdate,
  p.todate,
  p.data_date AS tradingdate,
  SUM(d.listedshare_value) AS listedshare_value
FROM period_trade_dates p
LEFT JOIN daily_listedshare d
  ON d.tradingdate = p.data_date
GROUP BY p.period_code, p.period_name, p.fromdate, p.todate, p.data_date
;
column25:
- Giá trị TP niêm yết gồm TPCP, TPDNNY (Trái phiếu doanh nghiệp niêm yết), TPDNRL (Trái phiếu doanh nghiệp riêng lẻ)
- Công thức: Giá trị TP niêm yết = KL TP niêm yết/ĐKGD * Mệnh giá
- Báo cáo Quý/6M/9M/Năm thì Giá trị TP niêm yết tính tại ngày giao dịch cuối mỗi kỳ.
-  TPDNNY: 
  + KL TP niêm yết lấy từ MDDS
  + Mệnh giá suy ngược từ giá tham chiếu theo nguyên tắc MG TP là bội số của 100000 và bước giá nhảy từ 100000 -> 1000000 -> 10000000 -> 100000000...
     Công thức tính MG TP = 100000 * 10^ROUND(LOG10(P_reference / 100000),0)
- TPDNRL: Lấy trường KL đăng ký giao dịch, Mệnh giá từ BM HNX - Quy mô đăng ký giao dịch và khối lượng đang lưu hành
- TPCP: 
  + KL TP: Trường Khối lượng niêm yết từ BM HNX - Dữ liệu về danh sách TPCP niêm yết
  + Mệnh giá: 100000

SELECT

  p.period_name,
  p.todate,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.ma_tkgd) AS so_luong_tkgd
FROM periods p
-- Lấy các tài khoản đã mở tính đến ngày cuối kỳ
LEFT JOIN vsdc_open_investors o 
  ON o.ngay_mo <= p.todate
-- Lấy ngày đóng tài khoản
LEFT JOIN vsdc_closed_investors c 
  ON o.ma_tkgd = c.ma_tkgd 
WHERE o.ma_tkgd IS NOT NULL

GROUP BY p.period_code, p.period_name, p.todate
;

--- Tong_KLGD, Tong_GTGD của CPNY toàn thị trường
SELECT Symbol as Ma_CK, status as trang_thai_GD,
sum(Khoi_luong) as Tong_KLGD,
SUM(exec_value) AS Tong_GTGD
FROM (
  SELECT sum("Execution_Value") AS exec_value, sum(Execution_Volume) as Khoi_luong
  Symbol,status
  FROM trade_hose
  WHERE "Market ID" = 'STK'
    AND "Trade Date" = :input_date
group by symbol,status
  UNION ALL
  SELECT sum(trade_price * trade_quantity) AS exec_value, sum(trade_quantity) as Khoi_luong
  FROM TRADE_BOOK
  WHERE "Market ID" IN ('STX','UPX')
    AND "Trade date" = :input_date
group by symbol,status
) t group by ymbol,status;

WITH PARAMS AS (
  -- Tham số kỳ báo cáo
  SELECT
    DECODE(:PERIOD_TYPE
      , 'D', ngay_gd(:PERIOD_TO, 'DD/MM/YYYY')
      , 'M', ngay_gd('01/' || :PERIOD_TO, 'DD/MM/YYYY')
      , 'Q', ADD_MONTHS(ngay_gd('01/01/' || SUBSTR(:PERIOD_TO, 4, 4), 'DD/MM/YYYY'),(TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(:PERIOD_TO, 1, 2)) - 1) * 3)
      , 'Y', ngay_gd('01/01/' || :PERIOD_TO, 'DD/MM/YYYY')
    ) AS PERIOD_TO_STARTDATE, -- Ngày bắt đầu kỳ 
    DECODE(:PERIOD_TYPE
      , 'D', ngay_gd(:PERIOD_TO, 'DD/MM/YYYY')
      , 'M', LAST_DAY(ngay_gd('01/' || :PERIOD_TO, 'DD/MM/YYYY'))
      , 'Q', ADD_MONTHS(ngay_gd('01/01/' || SUBSTR(:PERIOD_TO, 4, 4), 'DD/MM/YYYY'),TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(:PERIOD_TO, 1, 2)) * 3) - 1
      , 'Y', ngay_gd('31/12/' || :PERIOD_TO, 'DD/MM/YYYY')
    ) AS PERIOD_TO_ENDDATE -- Ngày kết thúc kỳ
  FROM DUAL
)
, PS AS (
  -- Danh sách chứng khoán phái sinh (Lấy bản ghi cuối mỗi ngày)
  SELECT 
    TRADINGDATE,
    SYMBOL,
    DERIVATIVE_PRODUCT
  FROM (
    SELECT 
      S.TRADINGDATE,
      S.SYMBOL,
      DECODE(S.STKCKTYPE, '4', 'HĐTL', '5', 'HĐ quyền chọn') || DECODE(SUBSTR(S.UNDERLYINGSYMBOL,1,2), 'GB', 'TPCP', S.UNDERLYINGSYMBOL) AS DERIVATIVE_PRODUCT, -- Sản phẩm phái sinh
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY S.TRADINGDATE, S.SYMBOL ORDER BY S.TRADINGTIME DESC) RN 
    FROM JAD_JAD_STKCKINFOR S
    CROSS JOIN PARAMS P
    WHERE S.FLOORCODE = '03' --Phái sinh
      AND S.TRADINGDATE >= P.PERIOD_TO_STARTDATE
      AND S.TRADINGDATE <  P.PERIOD_TO_ENDDATE + 1
  ) WHERE RN = 1
)
-- Chỉ tiêu OI
SELECT SUM("Khối lượng hợp đồng mở OI") OI
FROM "CSDLTT BM 2_Báo cáo về khối lượng mở cuối ngày" d
CROSS JOIN PARAMS p 
LEFT JOIN PS ON d."Mã hợp đồng" = PS.TRADINGDATE
WHERE d."Ngày" >= p.PERIOD_TO_STARTDATE
  AND d."Ngày" <  p.PERIOD_TO_ENDDATE + 1

      AND t."Trade Date" BETWEEN :dau_thang AND :cuoi_thang

        SELECT t."Trade Date" AS Trade_Date

        WHERE t."Market ID" IN ('STK','STX')

    )
)

WITH hnx_data AS 
( SELECT
        h.trade_date  AS Trade_Date,
        h.issue_code  AS symbolisin,
        SUM(h.trade_quantity ) AS Tong_KLGD,
        SUM(h.trade_quantity * h.trade_price ) AS Tong_GTGD
      , SUM(CASE WHEN  h.board_id in ('G1','G2','G3','G4','G7','G8') then  h.trade_quantity  else 0 end ) AS Tong_KLGD_KHOPLENH
      , SUM(CASE WHEN  h.board_id in ('G1','G2','G3','G4','G7','G8') then  (h.trade_quantity * h.trade_price)  else 0 end ) AS Tong_GTGD_KHOPLENH
      , SUM(CASE WHEN  h.board_id in ('T1','T2','T3','T4','T6','R1') then  h.trade_quantity  else 0 end ) AS Tong_KLGD_THOATHUAN
      , SUM(CASE WHEN  h.board_id in ('T1','T2','T3','T4','T6','R1') then  (h.trade_quantity * h.trade_price)  else 0 end ) AS Tong_GTGD_THOATHUAN
      , SUM(CASE WHEN  h.board_id in ('G4','T4','T6') then  h.trade_quantity  else 0 end ) AS Tong_KLGD_LO_LE
      , SUM(CASE WHEN  h.board_id in ('G4','T4','T6') then  (h.trade_quantity * h.trade_price)  else 0 end ) AS Tong_GTGD_LO_LE
    FROM uat_hnx_stg.trade_book h
    WHERE h.Market_ID IN ('STK', 'STX', 'UPX')  -- thị trường cổ phieu
           --- AND h.trade_date = :ngay_gd
    GROUP BY h.trade_date, h.issue_code
  ),
hose_data as 
 ( SELECT date_format(to_date(H.Trade_Date, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 'yyyyMMdd')   AS Trade_Date,
                  h.symbol,
                    SUM(h.execution_volume  ) AS Tong_KLGD,
                     SUM(h.execution_value) AS Tong_GTGD
                   , SUM(CASE WHEN  h.board_type  in ('G1','G2','G3','G4','G7','G8')         then  h.execution_volume  else 0 end ) AS Tong_KLGD_KHOPLENH
        , SUM(CASE WHEN  h.board_type  in ('G1','G2','G3','G4','G7','G8')   then  h.execution_value   else 0 end ) AS Tong_GTGD_KHOPLENH
        , SUM(CASE WHEN  h.board_type  in ('T1','T2','T3','T4','T6','R1')          then  h.execution_volume  else 0 end ) AS Tong_KLGD_THOATHUAN
        , SUM(CASE WHEN  h.board_type  in ('T1','T2','T3','T4','T6','R1')   then  h.execution_value   else 0 end ) AS Tong_GTGD_THOATHUAN
        , SUM(CASE WHEN  h.board_type  in ('G4','T4','T6')          then  h.execution_volume  else 0 end ) AS Tong_KLGD_LO_LE
        , SUM(CASE WHEN  h.board_type  in ('G4','T4','T6')      then  h.execution_value   else 0 end ) AS Tong_GTGD_LO_LE
    FROM uat_hose_stg.trade_book h
    WHERE h.Market_ID IN ('STK', 'STX', 'UPX')  -- thị trường cổ phieu
    ---and date_format(to_date(H.Trade_Date, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 'yyyyMMdd') = :ngay_gd
    GROUP BY date_format(to_date(H.Trade_Date, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 'yyyyMMdd'), h.symbol
), 
STOCK_DATA AS 
( 
    SELECT DISTINCT SYMBOL,symbolisin, STOCK_TYPE,FUND_TYPE, FloorCode,Trade_Date,TRADINGTIME, maturitydate,ContractMultiplier
        FROM (
                    SELECT --DISTINCT
                        s.symbol AS SYMBOL,
                        s.symbolisin as symbolisin,
                        s.tradingdate AS Trade_Date, 
                            s.StockType AS STOCK_TYPE,
                     s.FundType AS FUND_TYPE,
                     s.FloorCode,
                         S.TRADINGTIME,
                         s.maturitydate,
                         S.ContractMultiplier,
                           ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY TRADINGDATE, symbolisin ORDER BY TRADINGTIME DESC) RN 
                    FROM uat_mdds_stg.jad_stockinfor s
                          WHERE 1=1
                          and s.FloorCode IN ('02','04','10')  --- HNX, Upcom, HOSE
               -- AND s.TRADINGDATE = :ngay_gd
                           ) WHERE RN =1 
)
select Trade_Date,
       SUM(Tong_KLGD) AS Tong_KLGD,
       SUM(Tong_GTGD) AS Tong_GTGD,
       SUM(Tong_KLGD_KHOPLENH) AS Tong_KLGD_KHOPLENH,
       SUM (Tong_GTGD_KHOPLENH) AS Tong_GTGD_KHOPLENH,
       SUM(Tong_KLGD_THOATHUAN) AS Tong_KLGD_THOATHUAN,
       SUM(Tong_GTGD_THOATHUAN) AS Tong_GTGD_THOATHUAN,
       SUM(Tong_KLGD_LO_LE) AS Tong_KLGD_LO_LE,
       SUM(Tong_GTGD_LO_LE) AS Tong_GTGD_LO_LE
FROM 
(
select t.Trade_Date,
       SUM(t.Tong_KLGD) AS Tong_KLGD,
       SUM(t.Tong_GTGD) AS Tong_GTGD,
       SUM(t.Tong_KLGD_KHOPLENH) AS Tong_KLGD_KHOPLENH,

JOIN          STOCK_DATA f   ON f.symbolisin = t.symbolisin       --- 15/9/2026: UPDATE  HNX: issue_code là mã chứng khoán quốc tế. hnx.trade_book.issue_code = jad_stockInfor.symbolisin

                                        and date_format(to_date(f.Trade_Date, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 'yyyyMMdd') = t.Trade_Date        
group by t.Trade_Date

/* ================= BÁO CÁO BM030b_MSS: TPDN ===========================
 *  BÁO CÁO BM030b_MSS: Thống kê giao dịch toàn thị trường trái phiếu doanh nghiệp niêm yết
* 21/9/2026 -- Update mapping
 * =====================================================================*/
WITH hnx_data AS 
( SELECT
        h.trade_date  AS Trade_Date,
        h.issue_code  AS symbolisin
      , SUM(CASE WHEN  h.board_id in ('G1','G2','G3','G4','G7','G8') then  h.trade_quantity  else 0 end ) AS Tong_KLGD_KHOPLENH
      , SUM(CASE WHEN  h.board_id in ('G1','G2','G3','G4','G7','G8') then  (h.trade_quantity * h.trade_price)  else 0 end ) AS Tong_GTGD_KHOPLENH
      , SUM(CASE WHEN  h.board_id in ('T1','T2','T3','T4','T6','R1') then  h.trade_quantity  else 0 end ) AS Tong_KLGD_THOATHUAN
      , SUM(CASE WHEN  h.board_id in ('T1','T2','T3','T4','T6','R1') then  (h.trade_quantity * h.trade_price)  else 0 end ) AS Tong_GTGD_THOATHUAN
      , SUM(h.trade_quantity ) AS Tong_KLGD
      , SUM(h.trade_quantity * h.trade_price ) AS Tong_GTGD
      FROM uat_hnx_stg.trade_book h
    WHERE h.Market_ID IN ('HCX', 'BDO')  -- thị trường TPDN NY
           --- AND h.trade_date = :ngay_gd
    GROUP BY h.trade_date, h.issue_code
  ),
hose_data as 
 ( SELECT date_format(to_date(H.Trade_Date, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 'yyyyMMdd')   AS Trade_Date
                 , h.symbol
                   , SUM(CASE WHEN  h.board_type  in ('G1','G2','G3','G4','G7','G8')         then  h.execution_volume  else 0 end ) AS Tong_KLGD_KHOPLENH
        , SUM(CASE WHEN  h.board_type  in ('G1','G2','G3','G4','G7','G8')   then  h.execution_value   else 0 end ) AS Tong_GTGD_KHOPLENH
        , SUM(CASE WHEN  h.board_type  in ('T1','T2','T3','T4','T6','R1')          then  h.execution_volume  else 0 end ) AS Tong_KLGD_THOATHUAN
        , SUM(CASE WHEN  h.board_type  in ('T1','T2','T3','T4','T6','R1')   then  h.execution_value   else 0 end ) AS Tong_GTGD_THOATHUAN
              , SUM(h.execution_volume  ) AS Tong_KLGD
                   , SUM(h.execution_value) AS Tong_GTGD
    FROM uat_hose_stg.trade_book h
    WHERE h.Market_ID IN ('HCX', 'BDO')  -- thị trường cổ phieu
    ---and date_format(to_date(H.Trade_Date, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 'yyyyMMdd') = :ngay_gd
    GROUP BY date_format(to_date(H.Trade_Date, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 'yyyyMMdd'), h.symbol
), 
STOCK_DATA AS 
( 
    SELECT DISTINCT SYMBOL,symbolisin, STOCK_TYPE,FUND_TYPE, FloorCode,Trade_Date,TRADINGTIME, maturitydate,ContractMultiplier
        FROM (
                    SELECT --DISTINCT
                        s.symbol AS SYMBOL,
                        s.symbolisin as symbolisin,
                        s.tradingdate AS Trade_Date, 
                            s.StockType AS STOCK_TYPE,
                     s.FundType AS FUND_TYPE,
                     s.FloorCode,
                         S.TRADINGTIME,
                         s.maturitydate,
                         S.ContractMultiplier,
                           ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY TRADINGDATE, symbolisin ORDER BY TRADINGTIME DESC) RN 
                    FROM uat_mdds_stg.jad_stockinfor s
                          WHERE 1=1
                  --        and s.FloorCode IN ('02','04','10')  --- HNX, Upcom, HOSE
               -- AND s.TRADINGDATE = :ngay_gd
                           ) WHERE RN =1 
)
select Trade_Date,
       SUM(Tong_KLGD_KHOPLENH) AS Tong_KLGD_KHOPLENH,
       SUM (Tong_GTGD_KHOPLENH) AS Tong_GTGD_KHOPLENH,
       SUM(Tong_KLGD_THOATHUAN) AS Tong_KLGD_THOATHUAN,
       SUM(Tong_GTGD_THOATHUAN) AS Tong_GTGD_THOATHUAN,
       SUM(Tong_KLGD) AS Tong_KLGD,
       SUM(Tong_GTGD) AS Tong_GTGD
FROM 
(
select t.Trade_Date,
       SUM(t.Tong_KLGD) AS Tong_KLGD,
       SUM(t.Tong_GTGD) AS Tong_GTGD,
       SUM(t.Tong_KLGD_KHOPLENH) AS Tong_KLGD_KHOPLENH,
       SUM (t.Tong_GTGD_KHOPLENH) AS Tong_GTGD_KHOPLENH,
       SUM(t.Tong_KLGD_THOATHUAN) AS Tong_KLGD_THOATHUAN,
       SUM(t.Tong_GTGD_THOATHUAN) AS Tong_GTGD_THOATHUAN
FROM     hnx_data t
JOIN          STOCK_DATA f   ON f.symbolisin = t.symbolisin       --- 21/9/2026: UPDATE  HNX: issue_code là mã chứng khoán quốc tế. hnx.trade_book.issue_code = jad_stockInfor.symbolisin
                                        and date_format(to_date(f.Trade_Date, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 'yyyyMMdd') = t.Trade_Date        
group by t.Trade_Date
UNION ALL
select t.Trade_Date,
       SUM(t.Tong_KLGD) AS Tong_KLGD,
       SUM(t.Tong_GTGD) AS Tong_GTGD,
       SUM(t.Tong_KLGD_KHOPLENH) AS Tong_KLGD_KHOPLENH,
       SUM (t.Tong_GTGD_KHOPLENH) AS Tong_GTGD_KHOPLENH,
       SUM(t.Tong_KLGD_THOATHUAN) AS Tong_KLGD_THOATHUAN,
       SUM(t.Tong_GTGD_THOATHUAN) AS Tong_GTGD_THOATHUAN
FROM     hose_data t
JOIN          STOCK_DATA f   ON f.symbol = t.symbol       --- 15/9/2026: UPDATE  HNX: issue_code là mã chứng khoán quốc tế. hnx.trade_book.issue_code = jad_stockInfor.symbolisin
                                        and date_format(to_date(f.Trade_Date, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 'yyyyMMdd') = t.Trade_Date        
group by t.Trade_Date
)
GROUP BY Trade_Date
ORDER BY Trade_Date DESC ;

//*=========BM030e_MSS   ============
 * Thống kê giao dịch thị trường chứng chỉ quỹ, ETF và CW
 * cách 1===============================================*/
WITH HNX_DATA AS 
(
    SELECT
        h.trade_date  AS trade_date,
        h.Market_ID AS MARKET_ID,
        h.issue_code  AS symbolisin        ,                 --- MÃ CK  
        h.trade_quantity  AS TRADE_QTY,
        h.trade_price  AS TRADE_PRICE,
        H.trade_quantity * H.trade_price AS TRADE_VALUE,
        CASE  
                        WHEN h.Market_ID IN ('STK','STX')                                       THEN 'CPNY'
                        WHEN h.MARKET_ID IN ('HCX','BDO')                                       THEN 'TPDN'
                        WHEN h.MARKET_ID = 'DVX'                                                THEN 'Phái sinh'   --- CK phái sinh trên HNX
                        when H.MARKET_ID = 'UPX'                                                THEN 'UpCOM'    --- CP upcom
                        when h.market_id = 'BDX'                                                THEN 'TPCP'
                        ELSE 'KHAC' 
                END AS LOAI_CK,
        CASE WHEN h.buy_foreign_investor_type_code  IN ('10','20') THEN 'NN MUA'
                WHEN h.sell_foreign_investor_type_code  IN ('10','20') THEN 'NN BÁN'
                ELSE 'ĐỐI TƯỢNG KHÁC'
        END AS GD_NDTNN,
                CASE WHEN h.buy_client_house_classification   ='30'  THEN 'Tự doanh MUA'
                  WHEN h.sell_client_house_classification  ='30' THEN 'Tự doanh BÁN'
                ELSE 'Môi giới'
        END AS GD_TUDOANH,
        h.board_id   AS Board_ID,    --PHÂN LOẠI GIAO DỊCH THỎA THUẬN - KHỚP LỆNH
                CASE  WHEN h.board_id in ('G1','G2','G3','G4','G7','G8')   THEN 'GD KHỚP LỆNH'
                            WHEN h.board_id in ('T1','T2','T3','T4','T6','R1')     THEN 'GD THỎA THUẬN'
                                ELSE 'GD KHÁC'
                        END AS LOAI_GD
    FROM uat_hnx_stg.trade_book h
   -- WHERE h.trade_date = :ngay_gd
), 
HOSE_DATA AS 
(
    SELECT
        date_format(to_date(h.Trade_Date, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 'yyyyMMdd')  AS trade_date,
        h.Market_ID AS MARKET_ID,
        h.symbol   AS SYMBOL, 
        h.execution_volume   AS TRADE_QTY,
        h.execution_value   AS TRADE_VALUE,
        CASE  
                        WHEN h.Market_ID IN ('STK','STX')                                               THEN 'CPNY'
                        WHEN h.MARKET_ID IN ('HCX','BDO')                                       THEN 'TPDN'
                        WHEN h.MARKET_ID = 'DVX'                                                       THEN 'Phái sinh'  --CK phái sinh trên HNX
                        when H.MARKET_ID = 'UPX'                                                          THEN 'UpCOM'                 -- CP upcom
                        when h.market_id = 'BDX'                                                                 THEN 'TPCP'
                        ELSE 'KHAC' 
                END AS LOAI_CK,
                CASE WHEN h.buy_foreigner_investor_type  IN ('10','20') THEN 'NN MUA'
                WHEN h.sell_foreigner_investor_type  IN ('10','20') THEN 'NN BÁN'
                ELSE 'ĐỐI TƯỢNG KHÁC'
        END AS GD_NDTNN,
                CASE WHEN h.buy_client_house_classification_code    ='30' THEN 'Tự doanh MUA'
                  WHEN h.sell_client_house_classification_code  ='30' THEN 'Tự doanh BÁN'
                ELSE 'Môi giới'
        END AS GD_TUDOANH,
        h.board_type    AS Board_ID,    --PHÂN LOẠI GIAO DỊCH THỎA THUẬN - KHỚP LỆNH
                CASE  WHEN h.board_type in ('G1','G2','G3','G4','G7','G8')   THEN 'GD KHỚP LỆNH'
                           WHEN h.board_type in ('T1','T2','T3','T4','T6','R1')   THEN 'GD THỎA THUẬN'
                                ELSE 'GD KHÁC'
                END AS LOAI_GD               
    FROM uat_hose_stg.trade_book h
   -- WHERE h.trade_date = :ngay_gd
),
STOCK_DATA_HNX AS 
( 
    SELECT DISTINCT SYMBOL,symbolisin, STOCK_TYPE,FUND_TYPE, FloorCode,LOAI_CK,Trade_Date,TRADINGTIME, maturitydate,ContractMultiplier
        FROM (
               SELECT --DISTINCT
                        s.symbol AS SYMBOL,
                        s.symbolisin as symbolisin,
                        s.tradingdate AS Trade_Date, 
                        s.StockType AS STOCK_TYPE,
                                   s.FundType AS FUND_TYPE,
                             s.FloorCode,
                        S.TRADINGTIME,
                        s.maturitydate,
                        S.ContractMultiplier,
                    CASE  
                                                WHEN s.floorcode = '02' and  s.StockType in ( '4','5')                                                 THEN 'Phái sinh'     --CK phái sinh trên HNX
                                                when s.FloorCode = '02' and ( s.StockType = '1')                                                             THEN 'TPDN' 
                                                when s.FloorCode = '02' and ( s.StockType = '2')                                                             THEN 'CPNY'
                                                WHEN s.FloorCode = '02' and s.StockType = '3'                                                                       THEN 'CCQ'
                                                WHEN s.FloorCode = '02' and s.StockType = '6'                                                                       THEN 'ETF'
                                                WHEN s.floorcode = '03'                                                                                                                  THEN 'Phái sinh'  
                                                when s.floorcode = '04'                                                                                                                    THEN 'UpCOM' 
                                                WHEN s.FloorCode = '10' and s.StockType = '3'         AND s.FundType = 'M'                      THEN 'CCQ'
                                                WHEN s.FloorCode = '10' and s.StockType = '3'         AND s.FundType = 'E'                      THEN 'ETF'
                                                WHEN s.FloorCode = '10' AND s.StockType = '4'                                                                    THEN 'CW'
                                                when s.FloorCode = '10' and ( s.StockType = '1')                                                             THEN 'TPDN' 
                                                when s.FloorCode = '10' and ( s.StockType = '2')                                                             THEN 'CPNY'
                                                ELSE 'KHAC' 
                                        END AS LOAI_CK,
                   ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY TRADINGDATE, symbolisin ORDER BY TRADINGTIME DESC) RN 
              FROM uat_mdds_stg.jad_stockinfor s
                          WHERE 1=1
                                       -- AND s.TRADINGDATE = :ngay_gd
                           ) WHERE RN =1 
),
STOCK_DATA_HOSE AS 
( 
    SELECT DISTINCT SYMBOL,symbolisin, STOCK_TYPE,FUND_TYPE, FloorCode,LOAI_CK, Trade_Date,TRADINGTIME, maturitydate,ContractMultiplier
        FROM (
                    SELECT --DISTINCT
                        s.symbol AS SYMBOL,
                        s.symbolisin as symbolisin,
                        s.tradingdate AS Trade_Date, 
                        s.StockType AS STOCK_TYPE,
                        s.FundType AS FUND_TYPE,
                        s.FloorCode,
                        S.TRADINGTIME,
                        s.maturitydate,
                        S.ContractMultiplier,
                CASE  
                                                WHEN s.floorcode = '02' and s.StockType in ( '4','5')                                                 THEN 'Phái sinh'     --CK phái sinh trên HNX
                                                when s.FloorCode = '02' and s.StockType = '1'                                                             THEN 'TPDN' 
                                                when s.FloorCode = '02' and s.StockType = '2'                                                             THEN 'CPNY'
                                                WHEN s.FloorCode = '02' and s.StockType = '3'                                                               THEN 'CCQ'
                                                WHEN s.FloorCode = '02' and s.StockType = '6'                                                               THEN 'ETF'
                                                WHEN s.floorcode = '03'                                                                                                          THEN 'Phái sinh'  
                                                when s.floorcode = '04'                                                                                                            THEN 'UpCOM' 
                                                WHEN s.FloorCode = '10' and s.StockType = '3'         AND s.FundType = 'M'              THEN 'CCQ'
                                                WHEN s.FloorCode = '10' and s.StockType = '3'         AND s.FundType = 'E'              THEN 'ETF'
                                                WHEN s.FloorCode = '10' AND s.StockType = '4'                                                            THEN 'CW'
                                                when s.FloorCode = '10' and s.StockType = '1'                                                             THEN 'TPDN' 
                                                when s.FloorCode = '10' and s.StockType = '2'                                                            THEN 'CPNY'
                                                ELSE 'KHAC' 
                                        END AS LOAI_CK,
                        ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY TRADINGDATE, symbol ORDER BY TRADINGTIME DESC) RN 
                    FROM uat_mdds_stg.jad_stockinfor s
                          WHERE 1=1
                          -- AND s.TRADINGDATE = :ngay_gd
                           ) WHERE RN =1 
)
select Trade_Date,
       SUM(KLGD_CCQ) AS KLGD_CCQ,
       SUM (KLGD_ETF) AS KLGD_ETF,
       SUM(KLGD_CW) AS KLGD_CW,
       SUM(GTGD_CCQ) AS GTGD_CCQ,
       SUM(GTGD_ETF) AS GTGD_ETF,
       SUM(GTGD_CW) AS GTGD_CW,      
       SUM(KLGD_KHOPLENH_CCQ) AS KLGD_KHOPLENH_CCQ,
       SUM (KLGD_KHOPLENH_ETF) AS KLGD_KHOPLENH_ETF,
       SUM(KLGD_KHOPLENH_CW) AS KLGD_KHOPLENH_CW,
       SUM(GTGD_KHOPLENH_CCQ) AS GTGD_KHOPLENH_CCQ,
       SUM(GTGD_KHOPLENH_ETF) AS GTGD_KHOPLENH_ETF,
       SUM(GTGD_KHOPLENH_CW) AS GTGD_KHOPLENH_CW       
FROM 
(
select   h.trade_date  AS Trade_Date
       , h.symbolisin  AS symbolisin
      , SUM(CASE WHEN f.LOAI_CK = 'CCQ' then h.TRADE_QTY else 0 end) as KLGD_CCQ
      , SUM(CASE WHEN f.LOAI_CK = 'ETF' then h.TRADE_QTY else 0 end) as KLGD_ETF
      , SUM(CASE WHEN f.LOAI_CK = 'CW'  then h.TRADE_QTY else 0 end) as KLGD_CW
      , SUM(CASE WHEN f.LOAI_CK = 'CCQ' then H.TRADE_VALUE else 0 end) as GTGD_CCQ
      , SUM(CASE WHEN f.LOAI_CK = 'ETF' then H.TRADE_VALUE else 0 end) as GTGD_ETF
      , SUM(CASE WHEN f.LOAI_CK = 'CW'  then H.TRADE_VALUE else 0 end) as GTGD_CW      
      , SUM(CASE WHEN  f.LOAI_CK = 'CCQ' AND h.LOAI_GD = 'GD KHỚP LỆNH' then  h.TRADE_QTY   else 0 end ) AS KLGD_KHOPLENH_CCQ
      , SUM(CASE WHEN  f.LOAI_CK = 'ETF' AND h.LOAI_GD = 'GD KHỚP LỆNH' then  h.TRADE_QTY   else 0 end ) AS KLGD_KHOPLENH_ETF
      , SUM(CASE WHEN  f.LOAI_CK = 'CW' AND h.LOAI_GD = 'GD KHỚP LỆNH' then  h.TRADE_QTY   else 0 end ) AS KLGD_KHOPLENH_CW
      , SUM(CASE WHEN  f.LOAI_CK = 'CCQ' AND h.LOAI_GD = 'GD KHỚP LỆNH' then  H.TRADE_VALUE  else 0 end ) AS GTGD_KHOPLENH_CCQ
      , SUM(CASE WHEN  f.LOAI_CK = 'ETF' AND h.LOAI_GD = 'GD KHỚP LỆNH' then  H.TRADE_VALUE  else 0 end ) AS GTGD_KHOPLENH_ETF
      , SUM(CASE WHEN  f.LOAI_CK = 'CW' AND h.LOAI_GD = 'GD KHỚP LỆNH' then  H.TRADE_VALUE  else 0 end ) AS GTGD_KHOPLENH_CW     
FROM     HNX_DATA h
JOIN          STOCK_DATA_HNX f   ON f.symbolisin = H.symbolisin       --- 23/9/2026: UPDATE -- hnx.trade_book.issue_code = jad_stockInfor.symbolisin
                                      and date_format(to_date(f.Trade_Date, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 'yyyyMMdd') = H.Trade_Date        
group by H.Trade_Date, h.symbolisin
UNION ALL
select H.Trade_Date
          , H.symbol
      , SUM(CASE WHEN f.LOAI_CK = 'CCQ' then h.TRADE_QTY else 0 end) as KLGD_CCQ
      , SUM(CASE WHEN f.LOAI_CK = 'ETF' then h.TRADE_QTY else 0 end) as KLGD_ETF
      , SUM(CASE WHEN f.LOAI_CK = 'CW'  then h.TRADE_QTY else 0 end) as KLGD_CW
      , SUM(CASE WHEN f.LOAI_CK = 'CCQ' then H.TRADE_VALUE else 0 end) as GTGD_CCQ
      , SUM(CASE WHEN f.LOAI_CK = 'ETF' then H.TRADE_VALUE else 0 end) as GTGD_ETF
      , SUM(CASE WHEN f.LOAI_CK = 'CW'  then H.TRADE_VALUE else 0 end) as GTGD_CW      
      , SUM(CASE WHEN  f.LOAI_CK = 'CCQ' AND h.LOAI_GD = 'GD KHỚP LỆNH' then  h.TRADE_QTY   else 0 end ) AS KLGD_KHOPLENH_CCQ
      , SUM(CASE WHEN  f.LOAI_CK = 'ETF' AND h.LOAI_GD = 'GD KHỚP LỆNH' then  h.TRADE_QTY   else 0 end ) AS KLGD_KHOPLENH_ETF
      , SUM(CASE WHEN  f.LOAI_CK = 'CW' AND h.LOAI_GD = 'GD KHỚP LỆNH' then  h.TRADE_QTY   else 0 end ) AS KLGD_KHOPLENH_CW
      , SUM(CASE WHEN  f.LOAI_CK = 'CCQ' AND h.LOAI_GD = 'GD KHỚP LỆNH' then  H.TRADE_VALUE  else 0 end ) AS GTGD_KHOPLENH_CCQ
      , SUM(CASE WHEN  f.LOAI_CK = 'ETF' AND h.LOAI_GD = 'GD KHỚP LỆNH' then  H.TRADE_VALUE  else 0 end ) AS GTGD_KHOPLENH_ETF
      , SUM(CASE WHEN  f.LOAI_CK = 'CW' AND h.LOAI_GD = 'GD KHỚP LỆNH' then  H.TRADE_VALUE  else 0 end ) AS GTGD_KHOPLENH_CW    
FROM     hose_data H
JOIN          STOCK_DATA_HOSE f   ON f.symbol = H.symbol       
                                 and date_format(to_date(f.Trade_Date, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 'yyyyMMdd') = H.Trade_Date        
group by H.Trade_Date, H.symbol
)
GROUP BY Trade_Date
ORDER BY Trade_Date DESC ;

/*== DỮ LIỆU BÁO CÁO BM031a_MSS=================
 * =======================================*/
 --- -----------LẤY GIÁ TRỊ CHỈ SỐ: HNXIndex, VNIndex, HNX 30, VN30 
with chi_so as  
(
select * FROM 
(
SELECT 
       c.floorcode  
      , c.indexcode 
   --   , c.symbol 
      , m.marketcode
      , m.indexname
      , m.tradingdate
      , m.marketindex
      , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.marketcode, m.tradingdate ORDER BY m.indextime DESC) AS rn
FROM uat_mdds_stg.JAD_MarketInfor m
join uat_mdds_stg.JAD_CSIDXInfor c on m.marketcode = c.indexcode and m.tradingdate =c.tradingdate 
WHERE m.marketcode IN ('HNX', 'UPCOM','HOSE', '30','HNX30','100') 
   --- m.marketid ='02' -- in ('02','04','10')
)   WHERE rn = 1
),
stock_data_hnx as 
(
sELECT DISTINCT SYMBOL,symbolisin, STOCK_TYPE,FUND_TYPE, FloorCode,Trade_Date,TRADINGTIME, maturitydate,ContractMultiplier
        FROM (
                    SELECT --DISTINCT
                        s.symbol AS SYMBOL,
                        s.symbolisin as symbolisin,
                        s.tradingdate AS Trade_Date, 
                            s.StockType AS STOCK_TYPE,
                     s.FundType AS FUND_TYPE,
                     s.FloorCode,
                         S.TRADINGTIME,
                         s.maturitydate,
                         S.ContractMultiplier,
                           ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY TRADINGDATE, symbolisin ORDER BY TRADINGTIME DESC) RN 
                    FROM uat_mdds_stg.jad_stockinfor s
                          WHERE 1=1
                          and s.FloorCode IN ('02','04','10')  --- HNX, Upcom, HOSE
               -- AND s.TRADINGDATE = :ngay_gd
                           ) WHERE RN =1 
   ),
   stock_data_hose as 
(
sELECT DISTINCT SYMBOL,symbolisin, STOCK_TYPE,FUND_TYPE, FloorCode,Trade_Date,TRADINGTIME, maturitydate,ContractMultiplier
        FROM (
                    SELECT --DISTINCT
                        s.symbol AS SYMBOL,
                        s.symbolisin as symbolisin,
                        s.tradingdate AS Trade_Date, 
                            s.StockType AS STOCK_TYPE,
                     s.FundType AS FUND_TYPE,
                     s.FloorCode,
                         S.TRADINGTIME,
                         s.maturitydate,
                         S.ContractMultiplier,
                           ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY TRADINGDATE, symbol ORDER BY TRADINGTIME DESC) RN 
                    FROM uat_mdds_stg.jad_stockinfor s
                          WHERE 1=1
                          and s.FloorCode IN ('02','04','10')  --- HNX, Upcom, HOSE
               -- AND s.TRADINGDATE = :ngay_gd
                           ) WHERE RN =1 
   ),
   chi_so_data as  --- BẢNG CHỈ SỐ HNX
   (
   select c.*, s.*
   from chi_so c
   join stock_data_hnx s on c.floorcode = s.floorcode and c.tradingdate =s.Trade_Date
   ),
   chi_so_data_hose as   --- BẢNG CHỈ SỐ HOSE
   (
   select c.*, s.*
   from chi_so c
   join stock_data_hose s on c.floorcode = s.floorcode and c.tradingdate =s.Trade_Date
   ),
 hnx_data AS   
( SELECT
        h.trade_date  AS Trade_Date
      , h.issue_code  AS symbolisin
------I. TỔNG GIAO DỊCH MUA, BÁN CỦA NĐTNN
      , SUM(case when h.buy_foreign_investor_type_code  in ('10','20') then h.trade_quantity else 0 end) AS NN_Tong_KLGD_MUA
      , SUM(case when h.sell_foreign_investor_type_code in ('10','20') then h.trade_quantity else 0 end) AS NN_Tong_KLGD_BAN
      , SUM(case when h.buy_foreign_investor_type_code  in ('10','20') THEN (h.trade_quantity * h.trade_price) ELSE 0 END ) AS NN_Tong_GTGD_MUA
      , SUM(case when h.sell_foreign_investor_type_code  in ('10','20') THEN (h.trade_quantity * h.trade_price) ELSE 0 END ) AS NN_Tong_GTGD_BAN
                -----MUA BÁN THỎA THUẬN NĐTNN

WITH TRADE_DATA AS
(
    ------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- HNX
    ------------------------------------------------------------------
    SELECT
        h."Trade date" AS tradedate,
        j.indexcode AS chi_so,
        h."Buy client/house classification"  AS buy_class,
        h."Sell client/house classification" AS sell_class,
        h."Trade_quantity" AS volume,
        h."Trade_quantity" * h."Trade_price" AS value
    FROM TRADE_BOOK h
         JOIN JAD_CSIDXInfor j
           ON j.symbol = h.Issue_Code
    WHERE h."Market ID" IN ('STX','UPX')
      AND h."Board ID" IN ('G1','G2','G3','G4','G7','G8')
      AND h."Trade date" BETWEEN :from_date AND :ngay_gd

    UNION ALL

    ------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- HOSE
    ------------------------------------------------------------------
    SELECT
        h."Trade date" AS tradedate,
        j.indexcode AS chi_so,
        h."Buy client/house classification"  AS buy_class,
        h."Sell client/house classification" AS sell_class,
        h."Execution_Volume" AS volume,
        h."Execution_Value"  AS value
    FROM HOSE.TRADE_BOOK h
         JOIN JAD_CSIDXInfor j
           ON j.symbol = h.Symbol
    WHERE h."Market ID" = 'STK'
      AND h."Board Type" IN ('G1','G2','G3','G4','G7','G8')
      AND h."Trade date" BETWEEN :from_date AND :ngay_gd
),

SUMMARY AS
(
    SELECT
        tradedate,
        chi_so,

        /* Khối lượng */
        SUM(CASE WHEN buy_class  = '30' THEN volume ELSE 0 END) AS KL_TD_MUA,
        SUM(CASE WHEN sell_class = '30' THEN volume ELSE 0 END) AS KL_TD_BAN,

        /* Giá trị */
        SUM(CASE WHEN buy_class  = '30' THEN value ELSE 0 END) AS GT_TD_MUA,
        SUM(CASE WHEN sell_class = '30' THEN value ELSE 0 END) AS GT_TD_BAN

    FROM TRADE_DATA
    GROUP BY
        tradedate,
        chi_so
)

SELECT
    tradedate,
    chi_so,

    KL_TD_MUA,
    KL_TD_BAN,
    KL_TD_MUA + KL_TD_BAN AS TONG_KL_TD,

    GT_TD_MUA,
    GT_TD_BAN,
    GT_TD_MUA + GT_TD_BAN AS TONG_GT_TD

FROM SUMMARY
ORDER BY
    tradedate,
    chi_so;

/*=======BM031b_MSS:  Bảng dữ liệu giao dịch NĐTNN/tự doanh thị trường TPCP
 * 21/9/2026: UPDATE MAPPING
 *===================================*/
select trading_date
----GIAO DỊCH NĐTNN THỊ TRƯỜNG TPCP
        , sum(KL_NN_MUA)                        as KL_NN_MUA
        , sum(KL_NN_BAN)            as KL_NN_BAN
        , sum(GT_NN_MUA)            as GT_NN_MUA
        , sum(GT_NN_BAN)            as GT_NN_BAN
        , sum(KL_NN_MUA_lan1)                as KL_NN_MUA_lan1
        , sum(KL_NN_BAN_lan1)       as KL_NN_BAN_lan1
        , sum(GT_NN_MUA_lan1)                 as GT_NN_MUA_lan1
        , sum(GT_NN_BAN_lan1)                 as GT_NN_BAN_lan1
        , sum(KL_NN_MUA_lan2)             as KL_NN_MUA_lan2
        , sum(KL_NN_BAN_lan2)                 as KL_NN_BAN_lan2
        , sum(GT_NN_MUA_lan2)                as GT_NN_MUA_lan2
        , sum(GT_NN_BAN_lan2)                as GT_NN_BAN_lan2
---- GIAO DỊCH TỰ DOANH THỊ TRƯỜNG TPCP
        , sum(KL_TUDOANH_MUA)                         as KL_TUDOANH_MUA
        , sum(KL_TUDOANH_BAN)            as KL_TUDOANH_BAN
        , sum(GT_TUDOANH_MUA)            as GT_TUDOANH_MUA
        , sum(GT_TUDOANH_BAN)            as GT_TUDOANH_BAN
from 
( /* ---------- giao dịch thông thường ---------------- */
select         h.trading_date  as trading_date
    ,   sum(case when SUBSTR(buying_account_no, 4, 1) in ('F','E') then h.volume else 0 end) as KL_NN_MUA
        ,        sum(case when SUBSTR(selling_account_no, 4, 1) in ('F','E') then h.volume else 0 end) as KL_NN_BAN 
        ,        sum(case when SUBSTR(buying_account_no, 4, 1) in ('F','E') then h.trading_value else 0 end) as GT_NN_MUA
        ,        sum(case when SUBSTR(selling_account_no, 4, 1) in ('F','E') then h.trading_value else 0 end) as GT_NN_BAN
        ,        ''  as KL_NN_MUA_lan1
        ,        ''  as KL_NN_BAN_lan1
        ,        ''  as GT_NN_MUA_lan1
        ,        ''  as GT_NN_BAN_lan1
        ,        ''  as KL_NN_MUA_lan2
        ,        ''        as KL_NN_BAN_lan2
        ,        ''  as GT_NN_MUA_lan2
        ,        ''        as GT_NN_BAN_lan2
        ,        sum(case when h.buying_broker_dealer ='Tự doanh' then h.volume else 0 end) as KL_TUDOANH_MUA
        ,        sum(case when h.selling_broker_dealer ='Tự doanh' then h.volume else 0 end) as KL_TUDOANH_BAN
        ,        sum(case when h.buying_broker_dealer ='Tự doanh' then h.trading_value else 0 end) as GT_TUDOANH_MUA
        ,        sum(case when h.selling_broker_dealer ='Tự doanh' then h.trading_value else 0 end) as GT_TUDOANH_BAN
from  uat_hnx_stg.outright_order_book h
where 1=1 
group by h.trading_date
union all
                /* ---------- Giao dịch mua bán lại lần 1 ---------------- */
select  h1.trading_date as trading_date
        ,        '' as KL_NN_MUA
        ,        '' as KL_NN_BAN
        ,        '' as GT_NN_MUA
        ,        '' as GT_NN_BAN
        ,        sum(case when SUBSTR(h1.buying_account_no, 4, 1) in ('F','E') then h1.volume else 0 end) as KL_NN_MUA_lan1
        ,        sum(case when SUBSTR(h1.selling_account_no, 4, 1) in ('F','E') then h1.volume else 0 end) as KL_NN_BAN_lan1 
        ,        sum(case when SUBSTR(h1.buying_account_no, 4, 1) in ('F','E') then h1.first_settlement_value else 0 end) as GT_NN_MUA_lan1
        ,        sum(case when SUBSTR(h1.selling_account_no, 4, 1) in ('F','E') then h1.first_settlement_value else 0 end) as GT_NN_BAN_lan1
        ,        ''  as KL_NN_MUA_lan2
        ,        ''        as KL_NN_BAN_lan2
        ,        ''  as GT_NN_MUA_lan2
        ,        ''        as GT_NN_BAN_lan2
        ,        sum(case when h1.buying_broker_dealer ='Tự doanh' then h1.volume else 0 end) as KL_TUDOANH_MUA
        ,        sum(case when h1.selling_broker_dealer ='Tự doanh' then h1.volume else 0 end) as KL_TUDOANH_BAN
        ,        sum(case when h1.buying_broker_dealer ='Tự doanh' then h1.first_settlement_value else 0 end) as GT_TUDOANH_MUA
        ,        sum(case when h1.selling_broker_dealer ='Tự doanh' then h1.first_settlement_value else 0 end) as GT_TUDOANH_BAN
from uat_hnx_stg.repo_order_book h1
where 1=1 
--and Instrument_type = 'Bond'  -- TPCP
--and trading_date = '2026-09-04' ---:p_date
group by h1.trading_date
union all
                /* -----  Giao dịch mua bán lại lần 2 ---------------- */
select  h2.trading_date as trading_date
        ,        '' as KL_NN_MUA
        ,        '' as KL_NN_BAN
        ,        '' as GT_NN_MUA
        ,        '' as GT_NN_BAN
        ,        ''  as KL_NN_MUA_lan1
        ,        ''  as KL_NN_BAN_lan1
        ,        ''  as GT_NN_MUA_lan1
        ,        ''  as GT_NN_BAN_lan1
        ,        sum(case when SUBSTR(h2.buying_account_no, 4, 1) in ('F','E') then h2.volume else 0 end) as KL_NN_MUA_lan2
        ,        sum(case when SUBSTR(h2.selling_account_no, 4, 1) in ('F','E') then h2.volume else 0 end) as KL_NN_BAN_lan2 
        ,        sum(case when SUBSTR(h2.buying_account_no, 4, 1) in ('F','E') then h2.first_settlement_value else 0 end) as GT_NN_MUA_lan2
        ,        sum(case when SUBSTR(h2.selling_account_no, 4, 1) in ('F','E') then h2.first_settlement_value else 0 end) as GT_NN_BAN_lan2
        ,        sum(case when h2.buying_broker_dealer ='Tự doanh' then h2.volume else 0 end) as KL_TUDOANH_MUA
        ,        sum(case when h2.selling_broker_dealer ='Tự doanh' then h2.volume else 0 end) as KL_TUDOANH_BAN
        ,        sum(case when h2.buying_broker_dealer ='Tự doanh' then h2.first_settlement_value else 0 end) as GT_TUDOANH_MUA
        ,        sum(case when h2.selling_broker_dealer ='Tự doanh' then h2.first_settlement_value else 0 end) as GT_TUDOANH_BAN
from  uat_hnx_stg.repo2_order_book h2
where 1=1 
--and Instrument_type = 'Bond'  -- TPCP
--and trading_date = '2026-09-04' ---:p_date
group by trading_date
)
group by trading_date 
order by trading_date DESC;

/* ===== BÁO CÁO BM031c_MSS   : TPDN ===========================
 * Bảng dữ liệu giao dịch NĐTNN/tự doanh thị trường TPDN niêm yết
 * ========================================*/
WITH hnx_data AS 
( SELECT
        h.trade_date  AS Trade_Date,
        h.issue_code  AS symbolisin
        ------I. TỔNG GIAO DỊCH MUA, BÁN CỦA NĐTNN
      , SUM(case when h.buy_foreign_investor_type_code  in ('10','20') then h.trade_quantity else 0 end) AS NN_Tong_KLGD_MUA
      , SUM(case when h.sell_foreign_investor_type_code in ('10','20') then h.trade_quantity else 0 end) AS NN_Tong_KLGD_BAN
      , SUM(case when h.buy_foreign_investor_type_code  in ('10','20') THEN (h.trade_quantity * h.trade_price) ELSE 0 END ) AS NN_Tong_GTGD_MUA
      , SUM(case when h.sell_foreign_investor_type_code  in ('10','20') THEN (h.trade_quantity * h.trade_price) ELSE 0 END ) AS NN_Tong_GTGD_BAN
 -----II. TỔNG GIAO DỊCH MUA, BÁN TỰ DOANH
      , SUM(case when h.Buy_client_house_classification  ='30' then h.trade_quantity else 0 end) AS TUDOANH_Tong_KLGD_MUA
      , SUM(case when h.sell_client_house_classification ='30' then h.trade_quantity else 0 end) AS TUDOANH_Tong_KLGD_BAN
      , SUM(case when h.Buy_client_house_classification  ='30' THEN (h.trade_quantity * h.trade_price) ELSE 0 END ) AS TUDOANH_Tong_GTGD_MUA
      , SUM(case when h.sell_client_house_classification ='30' THEN (h.trade_quantity * h.trade_price) ELSE 0 END ) AS TUDOANH_Tong_GTGD_BAN  
    FROM uat_hnx_stg.trade_book h
    WHERE h.Market_ID IN ('HCX', 'BDO')  -- thị trường TPDN NY
           --- AND h.trade_date = :ngay_gd
    GROUP BY h.trade_date, h.issue_code
  ),
hose_data as 
 ( SELECT date_format(to_date(H.Trade_Date, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 'yyyyMMdd')   AS Trade_Date
                 , h.symbol
       ------I. TỔNG GIAO DỊCH MUA, BÁN CỦA NĐTNN
      , SUM(case when h.buy_foreigner_investor_type  in ('10','20') then h.execution_volume else 0 end) AS NN_Tong_KLGD_MUA
      , SUM(case when h.sell_foreigner_investor_type in ('10','20') then h.execution_volume else 0 end) AS NN_Tong_KLGD_BAN
      , SUM(case when h.buy_foreigner_investor_type  in ('10','20') THEN (h.execution_value) ELSE 0 END ) AS NN_Tong_GTGD_MUA
      , SUM(case when h.sell_foreigner_investor_type  in ('10','20') THEN (h.execution_value) ELSE 0 END ) AS NN_Tong_GTGD_BAN   
-----II. TỔNG GIAO DỊCH MUA, BÁN TỰ DOANH
      , SUM(case when h.buy_client_house_classification_code  ='30' then h.execution_volume else 0 end) AS TUDOANH_Tong_KLGD_MUA
      , SUM(case when h.sell_client_house_classification_code ='30' then h.execution_volume else 0 end) AS TUDOANH_Tong_KLGD_BAN
      , SUM(case when h.buy_client_house_classification_code  ='30' THEN (h.execution_value) ELSE 0 END ) AS TUDOANH_Tong_GTGD_MUA
      , SUM(case when h.sell_client_house_classification_code ='30' THEN (h.execution_value) ELSE 0 END ) AS TUDOANH_Tong_GTGD_BAN
    FROM uat_hose_stg.trade_book h
    WHERE h.Market_ID IN ('HCX', 'BDO')  -- thị trường cổ phieu
    ---and date_format(to_date(H.Trade_Date, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 'yyyyMMdd') = :ngay_gd
    GROUP BY date_format(to_date(H.Trade_Date, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 'yyyyMMdd'), h.symbol
), 
STOCK_DATA AS 
( 
    SELECT DISTINCT SYMBOL,symbolisin, STOCK_TYPE,FUND_TYPE, FloorCode,Trade_Date,TRADINGTIME, maturitydate,ContractMultiplier
        FROM (
                    SELECT --DISTINCT
                        s.symbol AS SYMBOL,
                        s.symbolisin as symbolisin,
                        s.tradingdate AS Trade_Date, 
                            s.StockType AS STOCK_TYPE,
                     s.FundType AS FUND_TYPE,
                     s.FloorCode,
                         S.TRADINGTIME,
                         s.maturitydate,
                         S.ContractMultiplier,
                           ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY TRADINGDATE, symbolisin ORDER BY TRADINGTIME DESC) RN 
                    FROM uat_mdds_stg.jad_stockinfor s
                          WHERE 1=1
               --        and s.FloorCode IN ('02','04','10')  --- HNX, Upcom, HOSE
               -- AND s.TRADINGDATE = :ngay_gd
                           ) WHERE RN =1 
)
select Trade_Date,
 --- mua bán NĐTNN
       SUM(NN_Tong_KLGD_MUA) AS NN_Tong_KLGD_MUA,
       SUM(NN_Tong_KLGD_BAN) AS NN_Tong_KLGD_BAN,
       SUM(NN_Tong_GTGD_MUA) AS NN_Tong_GTGD_MUA,
       SUM(NN_Tong_GTGD_BAN) AS NN_Tong_GTGD_BAN,
 ---- mua bán tự doanh
       SUM(TUDOANH_Tong_KLGD_MUA) AS TUDOANH_Tong_KLGD_MUA,
       SUM(TUDOANH_Tong_KLGD_BAN) AS TUDOANH_Tong_KLGD_BAN,
       SUM(TUDOANH_Tong_GTGD_MUA) AS TUDOANH_Tong_GTGD_MUA,
       SUM (TUDOANH_Tong_GTGD_BAN) AS TUDOANH_Tong_GTGD_BAN
FROM 
(
select t.Trade_Date,
 --- mua bán NĐTNN
       SUM(t.NN_Tong_KLGD_MUA) AS NN_Tong_KLGD_MUA,
       SUM(t.NN_Tong_KLGD_BAN) AS NN_Tong_KLGD_BAN,
       SUM(t.NN_Tong_GTGD_MUA) AS NN_Tong_GTGD_MUA,
       SUM(t.NN_Tong_GTGD_BAN) AS NN_Tong_GTGD_BAN,
 ---- mua bán tự doanh
       SUM(t.TUDOANH_Tong_KLGD_MUA) AS TUDOANH_Tong_KLGD_MUA,
       SUM(t.TUDOANH_Tong_KLGD_BAN) AS TUDOANH_Tong_KLGD_BAN,
       SUM(t.TUDOANH_Tong_GTGD_MUA) AS TUDOANH_Tong_GTGD_MUA,

column24:
---- Quy mô cung cầu - MUA (đã sửa: đếm SỐ LƯỢNG LỆNH ĐẶT MUA = số lệnh MỚI (New) trừ số lệnh HỦY (Cancel),
---- không chỉ lọc riêng lệnh New; dùng sổ LỆNH Order_HOSE/Order_HNX thay vì sổ khớp Trade_HOSE/Trade_HNX;
---- map Issue Code -> Symbol qua JAD_STKCKINFOR.symbolisin cho HNX; lấy trạng thái GD qua symbolstatuscode)
SELECT symbol, symbolstatuscode AS trang_thai_gd,
       SUM(so_lenh_new) - SUM(so_lenh_cancel) AS so_luong_lenh_dat_mua,
       SUM(kl_dat_mua)                        AS khoi_luong_dat_mua
FROM (
  -- HOSE: Side = 'B' la lenh mua; "Modify/Cancel": 'N' = lenh moi, 'C' = lenh huy
  SELECT r.symbol, r.symbolstatuscode,
         COUNT(CASE WHEN t."Modify/Cancel" = 'N' THEN 1 END) AS so_lenh_new,
         COUNT(CASE WHEN t."Modify/Cancel" = 'C' THEN 1 END) AS so_lenh_cancel,
         SUM(CASE WHEN t."Modify/Cancel" = 'N' THEN t."Order VOL" END) AS kl_dat_mua
  FROM Order_HOSE t
  JOIN JAD_STKCKINFOR r ON r.symbol = t."Symbol"
  WHERE t."Side" = 'B'
    AND ngay_gd(t."Trade Date",'DD/MM/YYYY') BETWEEN :tu_ngay AND :den_ngay
  GROUP BY r.symbol, r.symbolstatuscode

  UNION ALL

  -- HNX: Sell/Buy Classification Code = '2' la Buy; "Replace/cancel classification code": '1'=New, '2'=Replace, '3'=Cancel
  SELECT r.symbol, r.symbolstatuscode,
         COUNT(CASE WHEN t."Replace/cancel classification code" = '1' THEN 1 END) AS so_lenh_new,
         COUNT(CASE WHEN t."Replace/cancel classification code" = '3' THEN 1 END) AS so_lenh_cancel,
         SUM(CASE WHEN t."Replace/cancel classification code" = '1' THEN t."Order Quantity" END) AS kl_dat_mua
  FROM Order_HNX t
  JOIN JAD_STKCKINFOR r ON r.symbolisin = t."Issue Code"
  WHERE t."Sell/Buy Classification Code" = '2'
    AND ngay_gd(t."Trade date",'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN :tu_ngay AND :den_ngay
  GROUP BY r.symbol, r.symbolstatuscode
) t
GROUP BY symbol, symbolstatuscode;

---- Quy mô cung cầu - BÁN (đã sửa: đếm SỐ LƯỢNG LỆNH ĐẶT BÁN = số lệnh MỚI (New) trừ số lệnh HỦY (Cancel),
---- không chỉ lọc riêng lệnh New; dùng sổ LỆNH Order_HOSE/Order_HNX thay vì sổ khớp Trade_HOSE/Trade_HNX;
---- map Issue Code -> Symbol qua JAD_STKCKINFOR.symbolisin cho HNX; lấy trạng thái GD qua symbolstatuscode)
SELECT symbol, symbolstatuscode AS trang_thai_gd,
       SUM(so_lenh_new) - SUM(so_lenh_cancel) AS so_luong_lenh_dat_ban,
       SUM(kl_dat_ban)                        AS khoi_luong_dat_ban
FROM (
  -- HOSE: Side = 'S' la lenh ban; "Modify/Cancel": 'N' = lenh moi, 'C' = lenh huy
  SELECT r.symbol, r.symbolstatuscode,
         COUNT(CASE WHEN t."Modify/Cancel" = 'N' THEN 1 END) AS so_lenh_new,
         COUNT(CASE WHEN t."Modify/Cancel" = 'C' THEN 1 END) AS so_lenh_cancel,
         SUM(CASE WHEN t."Modify/Cancel" = 'N' THEN t."Order VOL" END) AS kl_dat_ban
  FROM Order_HOSE t
  JOIN JAD_STKCKINFOR r ON r.symbol = t."Symbol"
  WHERE t."Side" = 'S'
    AND ngay_gd(t."Trade Date",'DD/MM/YYYY') BETWEEN :tu_ngay AND :den_ngay
  GROUP BY r.symbol, r.symbolstatuscode

  UNION ALL

  -- HNX: Sell/Buy Classification Code = '1' la Sell; "Replace/cancel classification code": '1'=New, '2'=Replace, '3'=Cancel
  SELECT r.symbol, r.symbolstatuscode,
         COUNT(CASE WHEN t."Replace/cancel classification code" = '1' THEN 1 END) AS so_lenh_new,
         COUNT(CASE WHEN t."Replace/cancel classification code" = '3' THEN 1 END) AS so_lenh_cancel,
         SUM(CASE WHEN t."Replace/cancel classification code" = '1' THEN t."Order Quantity" END) AS kl_dat_ban
  FROM Order_HNX t
  JOIN JAD_STKCKINFOR r ON r.symbolisin = t."Issue Code"
  WHERE t."Sell/Buy Classification Code" = '1'
    AND ngay_gd(t."Trade date",'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN :tu_ngay AND :den_ngay
  GROUP BY r.symbol, r.symbolstatuscode
) t
GROUP BY symbol, symbolstatuscode;

  GROUP BY r.symbol, r.symbolstatuscode

         CASE WHEN h."Buy - Foreigner Investor type"  <> '00' THEN h."Execution_Volume" END,
         CASE WHEN h."Sell - Foreigner Investor type" <> '00' THEN h."Execution_Volume" END,
